focalElementsEn: pipeline engineer holding wrench beside released valve
sealed and intact material crate on ground
distant unverified pipeline section fading into shadow
visualBrief.imagePromptEn: A pipeline engineer in work vest stands beside a large brass valve he has just released, wrench in hand. At his feet rests a sealed wooden crate with intact metal bands. Behind him, the steam pipeline extends into dim industrial space where unverified sections disappear into shadow. Warm overhead lamp casts focused light on the freed valve and sealed crate, while distant pipes remain unlit.
